description: A sequencer over a four by four by four grid: a knob and a gate switch at every point of a four by four pad, with four such pads stacked behind one another

params.text: Jumps to that layer of the stack on each press and brings its sixteen knob settings back onto the panel
Sets the voltage at that point of the current layer, scaled by the range and shifted by the minimum; each layer keeps its own setting for this knob
Switches that point of the current layer between sounding and silent; each layer keeps its own setting for this switch
Steps one place along the X axis on each press, wrapping round after four
Steps one place along the Y axis on each press, wrapping round after four
Steps one place along the Z axis on each press, wrapping round after four
Steps one place along the raster scan on each press, which runs along X and drops to the next Y at the end of each row
Switches whether the output is snapped to whole semitones
Starts the sequencer on each press and stops it on the next; while it is stopped the CV inputs and trigger inputs are ignored
Returns all three axes to their first position on each press and fires the reset output
Draws fresh knob settings and gate switches for the current layer on each press, leaving the other three layers alone
Sets how many layers are gathered into the polyphonic outputs, 1 to 4, counting on from the current one
Sets the voltage the knobs are measured up from, -10V to 10V
Sets how many volts the knobs' full travel covers, 1 to 20, held so that the top of the range does not pass 10V
Attenuverts the minimum CV before it is added to the minimum knob
Attenuverts the range CV before it is added to the range knob

inputs.text: Sets the X position directly, 0-10V divided into four, which stops the X trigger inputs being read
A rise steps one place back along the X axis
A rise steps one place along the X axis
Sets the Y position directly, 0-10V divided into four, which stops the Y trigger inputs being read
A rise steps one place back along the Y axis
A rise steps one place along the Y axis
Sets the Z position directly, 0-10V divided into four, which stops the Z trigger inputs being read
A rise steps one place back along the Z axis
A rise steps one place along the Z axis
Changes the voltage the knobs are measured up from, added to the minimum knob through its attenuverter and clamped to -10 to 10V
Changes how many volts the knobs cover, added to the range knob through its attenuverter and clamped to 1 to 20
Sets the position along the raster scan directly, 0-10V divided into sixteen, which takes over from the X, Y and Z inputs altogether
A rise steps one place back along the raster scan
A rise steps one place along the raster scan
A rise starts the sequencer, and the next stops it
A rise returns all three axes to their first position and fires the reset output
A rise draws fresh knob settings and gate switches for the current layer
Added to every output voltage before the total is clamped to -10 to 10V

outputs.text: A 1ms 10V trigger whenever the sequencer is reset
A 1ms 10V trigger whenever any of the three positions changes
Carries 10V while the point reached is switched on, one polyphonic channel per layer counted on from the current one; the menu can turn it into a 1ms trigger instead
Carries 10V while the point reached is switched off, one polyphonic channel per layer counted on from the current one; the menu can turn it into a 1ms trigger instead
The voltage at the point reached, one polyphonic channel per layer counted on from the current one, snapped to semitones while QUANTIZE is on

notes: nothing moves on its own: the grid position comes from the CV jacks, the trigger jacks or the buttons, so the module needs a clock or a sequence from elsewhere
a cable in the SCAN CV jack takes over from the X, Y and Z jacks and buttons altogether, walking the sixteen points of the current layer in raster order
each layer holds its own sixteen knob settings and gate switches; the panel shows the current layer and the knobs jump when the layer changes
menu: Copy Layer — takes a copy of the current layer's sixteen knob settings and gate switches
Paste Layer — writes the copied knob settings and gate switches into the current layer
Paste to All Layers — writes the copied knob settings and gate switches into all four layers
Sample and Hold Active Step — holds the last sounding voltage through the silent points, instead of the output following the knob at every point
Enable Triggers from Gate Outputs — makes the two gate outputs fire a 1ms trigger on each step rather than holding a gate for the whole step
